meta.game: 魔王ミネリアと名もなき村のエロトラップダンジョン (v1.0, trial)
meta.source: Names harvested from Actors.json plus a manual read of the opening (Map031 OP1), the escape scenes (Map005), the tavern rumours (Map041) and the forest dark-mage encounter (Map006/Map036). Every entry below is hand-authored; nothing here was machine-guessed.
meta.note: This file is the CONTRACT. The whole roster ships in the cached system block on every request, so an edit here reaches every later line. `note` is human-facing and is deliberately NOT sent to the model. Creature nouns are lowercase on purpose: Enemies.json is empty, so they are never a database label and only ever appear in prose.
meta.honorific_policy: DROP. The corpus contains no personal-name honorifics at all - 205 hits on 様 are all on titles (魔王様 / サメラ様 / ミネリア様), and every さん/ちゃん/くん hit is a false positive inside an ordinary word (たくさん, ちゃんと, くんねえ). Render 様 as an English title, never as -sama.

ミネリア.role: THE PROTAGONIST. The Demon Lord - strongest being in the world, centuries old, terminally bored. She built an 'ero trap dungeon' out of a human book for entertainment, got caught in her own dungeon with her magic drained, and now has to escape it.
ミネリア.register: TWO VOICES, and the split is the whole joke. AT FULL POWER she is archaic, imperious and grammatically masculine-neutral: 我, 貴様, 〜だ/〜ぞ/〜のだ, 褒めてやろう, 退屈だ. Render that as cold, formal, faintly antique English - 'I', 'you', but 'Speak.' not 'Talk to me!'. DEPOWERED (99% of the game) she is a bratty, proud, easily flustered girl: 私, あんた, 〜わ, 〜のよ, 〜かしら, 〜なさいよ, ちょっと！. Render that as modern, sharp, exasperated English.
ミネリア.note: 1,224 of the 2,486 dialogue units are hers, detected by the LL_StandingPictureMV portrait code. Lines wrapped in （） are her inner monologue and must stay parenthesised.

サメラ.role: The Demon Lord Army's greatest dark mage (魔王軍最高の闇魔導士), ranked alongside Gigant Orc among its high commanders. Loyal to Mineria and turns up wherever she goes; also the taunting dark-mage encounter in the Bewildering Forest.
サメラ.register: Bright, sing-song, faintly smug deference toward Mineria - 〜ですかー with a drawn-out vowel, ふふん, ミネリア様. Grandiose when introducing herself (我こそは…サメラ様だ！！). Keep the mismatch between the cutesy delivery and the self-important content.
サメラ.note: Gender read from register and from how she is treated, not from the name. If a scene contradicts this, the scene wins - correct this field, do not paper over it.

ヴァルギス.role: The Netherlord (冥王). Storms the castle in the opening to take Mineria's head and is destroyed in a single hit before he finishes his sentence.
ヴァルギス.register: Formal villain boilerplate - 我が名は…, 貴様の命もらい受けるぞ. He is a joke, so play the bombast straight and let the punchline land.
ヴァルギス.note: Appears twice: the opening cutscene, and as a tavern rumour.

カイゼル.role: The Sword God (剣神カイゼル), a legend humans still tell stories about. In the flashback he is the doddering old man the hero party mocks, right up until he is not.
カイゼル.register: Old-man speech - わし, 〜じゃ, 〜じゃよ. Self-effacing ('I am just a worn-out old man, the sort you find anywhere') in a way that is funnier the more you know.
カイゼル.note: Distinct from エロゴン below. Both are legendary old men and they must NOT be merged.

エロゴン.role: The Archmage (大魔導士エロゴン), named only in a tavern rumour. Almost certainly the エロジジイ ('lecherous old geezer') Mineria remembers explaining magic-type trap dungeons to her centuries ago.
エロゴン.register: Never speaks on screen in this build.
エロゴン.note: DO NOT MERGE with カイゼル. The name is a pun on エロ; keep the joke in English - Erogon reads it fine.

ギガントオーク.role: 'Gigant Orc of Great Strength' (剛力のギガントオーク), a high commander of the Demon Lord Army, named as Samera's opposite number.
ギガントオーク.register: Never speaks on screen in this build.
aliases: 剛力のギガントオーク
ギガントオーク.note: Keep the katakana reading Gigant, not Giant - the source deliberately uses ギガント.

terms.淫乱度が回復: Lewdness goes DOWN - render as 'Lowers Lewdness by N', never 'Recovers N Lewdness'
terms.淫乱度を回復: Lewdness goes DOWN - render as 'Lowers Lewdness by N'
terms.上限: max (in an item description's carry-limit parenthetical: '(max 3)')

do_not_translate: 右クリック  -- MessageWindowHidden.js:334 matches this with `case '右クリック':` against the triggerButton parameter. Translating it disables right-click-to-hide the message window, with no error and no crash.
Every MapInfos.json `name` -- that is the editor's map tree. MapNameExtend has 実名表示 = false, so the tree name is never drawn; only Map*.json `displayName` reaches the screen.
Every System.json `switches` and `variables` entry -- plugins and events resolve these by NAME as string keys.

Any \F[..] \FF[..] \AA[..] \M[..] \FH[..] run -- LL_StandingPictureMV portrait, focus, motion and hold codes. The pipeline peels these off before the model sees a line and re-prepends them byte-exact.
